checkpoints.title: First domain or encoding checkpoint
checkpoints.contract: The small immutable first checkpoint described in its source; no later service features are claimed.

checkpoints.title: Deterministic simulated order domain
checkpoints.contract: A single synthetic symbol uses integer cents and whole shares. Quotes require increasing sequence numbers; orders retain stable logical IDs and an original accepted price. Purchases and sales use checked arithmetic, prohibit negative cash/shares, retain at most64 orders, and reject without partial state changes. No files, HTTP, watchlists, replay jobs, chart, or actual trading exists.

checkpoints.title: Complete reference implementation
checkpoints.contract: The current complete reference source with its documented limits, fixtures, tests and operational requirements. Database tests remain explicit opt-in checks where applicable.
